title: Decide whether useSuspendableSelector is adopted or deleted
body:
## Summary
A documented convention has no consumer.

## Description
The Suspend/LRU convention names this selector, but no code uses it, so hidden modules keep their Zustand subscriptions. It also never freezes a selector that returns undefined.

## Flow
- Choose adoption or deletion; update .claude/CLAUDE.md and the doc to match

## Expected impact
Removes a documented pattern nobody follows, or makes it real.

## Evaluation
Claim: The documented API has no consumer
Before: 0 call sites
After: a decision, then either adopters or no export
Method: argument
Result: unknown
Gate: direction
evidence: grep "useSuspendableSelector(" src: 0 call sites outside src/hooks/useSuspend.ts; .claude/CLAUDE.md and docs/architecture/runtime-patterns.md:187 present it as the pattern; src/hooks/useSuspend.ts:71 treats a selected undefined as not frozen
instrument: operator decision: adopt in a named module or retire the convention

title: useCRUD keeps the previous endpoint data while the new one loads
body:
## Summary
After a key change the old list is shown as if current.

## Description
The race fix stops late overwrites, but between the switch and the answer data still belongs to the previous endpoint. Resetting to initial would change every keyed caller, so it needs a per-caller look.

## Flow
- Add resetOnEndpointChange or expose the data key

## Expected impact
No wrong-catalog rows during a switch.

## Evaluation
Claim: Old rows render under the new key
Before: rows from the old catalog visible while loading
After: 0 rows from the old catalog
Method: argument
Result: unknown
Gate: none
evidence: src/hooks/useCRUD.ts:53 data persists across endpoint change; src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-forge/IconSetPanel.tsx:56 keys the endpoint on catalogId
instrument: render IconSetPanel, switch catalog with a held response, count rows of the old catalog shown

title: Two useLiveStateSync hosts bridge the same client into the store
body:
## Summary
Each mounted host calls setLiveState for every client change.

## Description
The store patch is a no-op on the second call, but the diff runs twice per message. Hidden hosts bridge too, as the hook is not suspend-aware.

## Flow
- Move the bridge to a single reference-counted subscription

## Expected impact
Half the store diffs per message if both panels are mounted.

## Evaluation
Claim: Bridge work scales with mounted hosts
Before: unmeasured
After: 1 setLiveState per message
Method: argument
Result: unknown
Gate: none
instrument: count setLiveState calls per WS message with both panels mounted

title: useBuildRun drops the result of an abort request
body:
## Summary
A refused abort is invisible.

## Description
The comment relies on the next poll to settle the run, but a refused abort leaves it running with no message. The fix needs a reducer event in lib/ue5-bridge, outside this context.

## Flow
- Add an abortFailed event and surface its reason

## Expected impact
The operator learns the build is still running.

## Evaluation
Claim: A refused abort shows nothing
Before: no message
After: the reason is shown
Method: argument
Result: unknown
Gate: none
evidence: src/hooks/useBuildRun.ts:68 void postBuild abort; src/lib/ue5-bridge/build-run.ts reducer has no abort-failed event
instrument: test: abort POST answers 500, assert the UI names the failure

title: useBatchReview hides repeated poll failures behind a running state
body:
## Summary
The panel can read Reviewing indefinitely.

## Description
useBuildRun goes lost after MAX_MISSED_POLLS; this poll has no equivalent, so a dead server looks like progress.

## Flow
- Count missed polls and expose a stale state

## Expected impact
A dead poll is stated.

## Evaluation
Claim: Pair: useBuildRun has a missed-poll limit, this has none
Before: 0 signal after any number of failures
After: stale state after N misses
Method: argument
Result: unknown
Gate: none
instrument: test: batch running, every GET fails, assert a stale or lost state appears

title: useFileWatcher catch labelled parse errors also swallows handler errors
body:
## Summary
A throw while handling changes is silent.

## Description
The try covers both parsing and handling, so a fault in handleChanges looks like a bad frame.

## Flow
- Narrow the try to JSON.parse and log the rest

## Expected impact
Handler faults become visible.

## Evaluation
Claim: Handler errors are discarded
Before: 0 logs
After: 1 warn per fault
Method: argument
Result: unknown
Gate: none
instrument: test: a changes frame whose handling throws, assert a logger.warn

title: File-watcher verdicts can land after a project switch
body:
## Summary
A slow verify from project A ticks items in project B.

## Description
semanticVerify captures the old path and writes on return. moduleStore holds one project at a time, so module and item ids collide across projects.

## Flow
- Recheck the current projectPath before writing

## Expected impact
No cross-project ticks.

## Evaluation
Claim: A late verdict writes into the wrong project
Before: write lands
After: no write
Method: argument
Result: unknown
Gate: none
evidence: src/hooks/useFileWatcher.ts:103 void semanticVerify; src/hooks/useFileWatcher.ts:75 writes to useModuleStore with no project recheck; src/stores/moduleStore.ts:224 setVerification is not keyed by project
instrument: test: switch projectPath while verify-semantic is pending, assert no write to the new project

title: useTestRunner timing constants bypass UI_TIMEOUTS
body:
## Summary
Two local timing values break the stated convention.

## Description
The poll interval is 2 s here and 3 s in UI_TIMEOUTS, so the fix needs a decision on the value and an edit to constants.ts, outside this context.

## Flow
- Add testPollInterval and testPollTimeout

## Expected impact
One timing table.

## Evaluation
Claim: 2 local constants
Before: 2
After: 0
Method: argument
Result: unknown
Gate: none
evidence: src/hooks/useTestRunner.ts:17; src/hooks/useTestRunner.ts:20; src/lib/constants.ts:85 pollInterval 3000; .claude/CLAUDE.md Timing Constants
instrument: grep local ms constants against UI_TIMEOUTS after adding the two keys

title: useDynamicTitle restores an empty favicon when none existed
body:
## Summary
Restoring writes href to an empty string.

## Description
If no icon link existed, the hook creates one and later assigns an empty href, leaving an element that points at nothing.

## Flow
- Remove the created link on restore

## Expected impact
Clean restore.

## Evaluation
Claim: An empty-href link remains
Before: 1 element
After: 0
Method: argument
Result: unknown
Gate: none
instrument: test: no icon link at first paint, run then finish, assert the created link is removed

title: Four shared hooks have no direct test
body:
## Summary
Small browser primitives are unpinned.

## Description
Each has 1-2 callers and simple logic, so the value is regression protection only.

## Flow
- Add one contract test each

## Expected impact
4 fewer unpinned hooks.

## Evaluation
Claim: 0 tests on 4 hooks
Before: 0
After: at least 1 each
Method: argument
Result: unknown
Gate: none
evidence: grep src/__tests__: useDebouncedValue, useElementSize, useScrollRestoration, useCoarsePointer each 0 files
instrument: coverage count per hook after adding contract tests
